text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Students from the school run by Air 
Groove's mother were visiting for a trial 
enrollment, and I ended up helping out 
with odd jobs.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Whoa—! Amazing~! It's so spacious~! The 
turf is so pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~, don't get too excited and trip 
over yourselves, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Trainer over there, make sure there are no 
oversights in the upcoming mock class. I'm 
counting on you to support the children 
thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...And so, after a race, eating 
'carbohydrates' like bananas or rice balls 
helps your body recover—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BRRRRRRRRRRRR—)

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaaah—!! What's that...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh, this sound is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello, is this security? We need an urgent 
confirmation of the situation—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, what was that loud noise...!?" "I 
know! It's the thing that rings when a 
fire goes whoosh!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, there's a fire!? That's super bad!" 
"Everyone run! Come on, hurry hurry!" 
"Ugh, I'm scared... *sob* *sniff*..."
choice_data_list:
Everyone, calm down and be quiet for a 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright everyone, eyes on meee~☆ 
Times like this are when we stay calm! 
Don't scatter around, let's bring our 
feelings together!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
First, let's all loosen our shoulders~! 
Copy what I do. Ready, and... 
wiggle-wiggle~.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Wi... wiggle-wiggle~...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, I hear you. I see... It's likely the 
alarm in the kitchenette, then. We will 
begin evacuation just in case.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Okay everyone~, we're going to head 
outside now~!
choice_data_list:
Let's go in order, starting from the 
hallway side.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This way! We will take the route leading 
as far away from the kitchenette as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Alriiight, walk, don't run, okay~! Keep 
proper distance from the people around 
you! One-two, one-two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the evacuation began, Air Groove 
immediately took the lead at the front. 
Her mother, meanwhile, watched over the 
children from the very rear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tch... This is not good. The fire shutter 
here is closed.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Does that mean we can't escape...? 
No way! I wanna go outside...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Doesn't that sound fun, 
though?♪ Let's go on an adventure together 
and find the maze's exit~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
An adventure...! Oh yeah, it's an 
adventure~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the flawless coordination of the 
mother and daughter, operating in perfect 
unspoken harmony, the evacuation was a 
complete success, and afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems the children made it home safely. 
...I am truly relieved it was just a 
malfunction of the alarm.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though I certainly never expected we would 
be conducting an evacuation drill during a 
trial enrollment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come on, all's well that ends well, right? 
We were able to resume the trial 
afterward, and it surely became a fond 
memory for those kids!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was all thanks to Mother's assistance. 
And... Trainer over there, good work as 
well.
choice_data_list: No, it was thanks to your combination.
No, it was thanks to your combination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, had the two of them not been 
there, chaos would have erupted and a 
smooth evacuation would have been 
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we were totally in sync, weren't we? 
We make the ultimate pair, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
By supporting each other, we can make our 
strengths shine even brighter! Together, 
we can do anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess this is what mother-daughter 
bonds are all about~! Right, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: !! M... Mother...! I am deeply honored...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're still doing that formal 
routine~!? Well, that's fine too. It's 
just like you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and her mother. Though a bit 
unconventional, I was able to witness the 
wonderful relationship they share.
